The selected owned work metrics are already returned in full. No per-metric detail command exists; a metric name is not an aweme_id.

Public user videos and optional top comments are returned. No public video-detail, selected-video comments or download command exists; owned-work stats/update/delete cannot be applied to another user videos.

Public video cards contain video URLs and display names only. No public video-detail or selected-video comments command exists, and author names are not sec_uid. Creator stats/update/delete are not valid public-card follow-ups.
